title: The Quiet Room in the Loud City

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Seeking a moment alone, a villager wonders whether people in crowded places have anywhere to be quiet.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Seeking a moment alone, (name1) wonders whether people in crowded places have anywhere to be quiet.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The villager finds the idea exhausting.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A teenager thinks it sounds exciting.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An elder imagines small gardens or rooms where people go to rest their minds.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A scholar suggests that quiet might be precious there, like fresh water in a dry season.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The villager walks to the far beach and enjoys the silence.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A friend follows to chat, and the villager kindly asks for some time alone.
